commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+7' Assane Diao (Betis) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
90+4' The attendance is 18757.
90+3' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Thierno Barry (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+3' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Francisco Vieites comes off his line to intercept.
88' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Sergi Altimira (Betis) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Natan.
87' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) picks up a yellow card.
86' Alex Baena (Villarreal) tries to put the rebound into the net from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him.

85' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
80' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
79' The ball possession is 57:43.

79' Villarreal slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
78' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
77' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Isco (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aitor Ruibal (Betis) replacing Abde Ezzalzouli.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovani Lo Celso departs the field of play to be replaced by Isco (Betis).
73' Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul.
72' Villarreal are ruled offside.
70' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Yeremy Pino will be replaced by Pau Cabanes (Villarreal).
70' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
68' That's the end of the game for Vitor Roque, who is replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).
68' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Guillermo Cuadra had a clear view and blows his whistle.
67' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is yellow-carded.
66' That's a well-taken pass by Alex Baena (Villarreal). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
65' Vitor Roque (Betis) gets a yellow card.
65' Betis fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
64' Betis fail to score from a corner as Junior Reis (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball. Betis will take a corner kick.
63' Vitor Roque (Betis) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
63' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

63' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends a long ball forward to Abde Ezzalzouli, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
61' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
60' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is punished with the yellow card.
59' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
57' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) replaces Pape Gueye.
55' 1 - 2 A goal! Alex Baena (Villarreal) broke through the defence and struck a shot inside the right post.
54' A pass from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is intercepted by Francisco Vieites and the move breaks down.
52' The resulting free kick from Alex Baena (Villarreal) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
50' Having seen unsporting behavior, Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is the recipient.
47' 0 - 2 Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the right post.
46' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sergi Cardona (Villarreal). Betis earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
46' Substitution. Juan Bernat (Villarreal) in, Eric Bailly out.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' A player from Villarreal commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+1' A pass into the penalty area from Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) is intercepted by the defence.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
44' Looks like Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' The yellow card goes to Kiko Femenia (Villarreal).
38' Villarreal are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Referee Guillermo Cuadra has finally had enough of Manuel Pellegrini and brandishes a yellow card at him!
36' Although Manuel Pellegrini (Betis) is just on the bench, Guillermo Cuadra has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
36' Having seen unsporting behavior, Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is the recipient.
35' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is given a yellow card.
34' The referee makes a quick call and awards Chimy Avila (Betis) a red card.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! Vitor Roque (Betis) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Abde Ezzalzouli.
29' None of the Betis players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

28' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the left side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Junior Reis.
26' A yellow card is awarded to Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
25' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
20' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
18' Good movement by Chimy Avila (Betis), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
17' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
13' The Betis players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Alex Baena with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
8' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
7' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Villarreal is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

4' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Francisco Vieites makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.
3' The Villarreal players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
1' The first half has just begun.
Villarreal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Guillermo Cuadra.
